x-changelog.summary: Company Action Plan Type names are now immutable after creation
x-changelog.description:
The PATCH endpoint for Company Action Plan Types no longer accepts the `name` parameter.
Type names can only be set during creation (POST) and cannot be modified afterward.
This change improves API security by aligning backend parameter validation with 
frontend functionality. Other fields such as `active` remain editable.
